text:
miriam: Heads up — noticed a weird tooltip/null metric when you hover over the crosstab cells in the scorecard drilldown after the latest quantized-runner push. chart freezes for ~1s then tooltip says 'metric: null' :confused:
cheng: I can repro. Steps: open scorecard -> diff view -> click cohort A vs B -> open crosstab -> hover middle row. Repro rate ~4/5 for me.
sam: same here on prod-staging, not on local dev. Could be a telemetry field that the frontend expects but runner changed the key name.
miriam: @sam do you have the failing payload?
sam: pasted sample payload from network tab: ```json
{"sample_id":"abc123","metric_values":[{"name":"rouge","value":0.42},{"name":"ppl","value":null}],"variant":"quant-v1"}
```
and the tooltip component does: `const v = row.metrics.find(m => m.key === k).value` so null propagates.
cheng: But why freeze the chart? null shouldn't cause animation block. There's a stacktrace in console pointing to tooltip render doing a reduce on buckets.
eval-bot: CI flaky test alert: `scorecard-drilldown-render` failed 3/10 since 2325879000 — log attached.
andrew: I dug into the runner change: we renamed `ppl` -> `perplexity` in the spillover telemetry mapping but added a compatibility alias in the ingest path. Looks like a race where some eval runs still emit old key but with null value for some metrics after quantization.
julia: Could be metric canonicalization order: frontend expects canonical keys present even if null; our UI code doesn't guard against undefined path on nested arrays. Quick fix: guard `?.value ?? '—'` and avoid reduce on null.
miriam: Pragmatic plan: 1) frontend patch for graceful nulls (PR ready: cheng/null-tooltip-guard) 2) add telemetry lint in CI to flag missing canonical metric keys 3) backfill a small transform in the ingest to coerce missing metrics to explicit nulls so UI sees consistent shape.
cheng: opened PR and pushed; CI shows one flaky test unrelated (snapshot). PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4892
sam: re: telemetry lint — we can add a unit in eval-runner that enforces schema per-metric with a failing test when keys are missing. I can take that.
andrew: Also adding a small guard in the scorecard reducer so any metric array missing the expected key returns an empty slot instead of undefined. I'll file a quick patch.
julia: For triage — are any customer-facing alerts triggered? I couldn't find SLO hits, just UI oddness.
miriam: No customer alerts yet, only internal reports. But this could confuse CS. Let's get the frontend patch shipped today and the lint early next week.
sam: Repro harness note: I'm creating a mini-eval runner job that emits mixed key sets + nulls to validate UI robustness; will add to CI smoke matrix once stable.
cheng: After frontend patch, I verified in staging: hover shows '—' and no freeze. We still want the telemetry lint tho.
eval-bot: Deploy bot: cheng/null-tooltip-guard merged and deployed to staging at 2325890100.
miriam: Great — thanks all. Assigning follow-ups: sam -> runner schema test, andrew -> reducer guard, julia -> CI lint spec. I'll message CS so they know it was UI-only. :thumbsup:
